annotations.title: Check Arabic, Urdu or Persian text

description: Check Arabic, Urdu or Persian text for problems that break PDFs, search and copy-paste: pre-shaped glyph characters and reversed letter order (typical of text copied out of a broken PDF), Persian or Urdu letters mixed into Arabic and the reverse, hidden direction-control characters, mixed digit systems, and characters the fonts cannot print. Returns the issues in English and Arabic and, when a safe fix exists, a fixed version of the text for the user to review. Deterministic rules; no AI.
name: check_arabic_text

fixed_text.description: A corrected version of the text, when a safe fix exists.
fixed_text.title: Fixed Text
